## Evidence Loop

- observe: The control-plane projection depends on a contracts-owned Figma coverage mirror, so local generated-client decisions can drift if mirror limits and projection rules are only prose.
- hypothesis: A projection manifest can make the upstream Figma SSOT, mirrored limitations, absorbed legacy nodes, and generated-client path checks executable in this repository.
- execute: Verify the local projection against the mirrored contracts coverage, generated TypeScript paths, annotation policies, and forbidden endpoint fragments.
- evaluate: The projection tests fail on stale mirrors, missing generated paths, unexpected endpoint claims, annotation policy drift, or source-coverage mismatch.
- retrospective: This lets control-plane consume design coverage without becoming the Figma source of truth or inventing API paths from local prose.
